title: An accessible reproduction of a Dafny-style robustness certifier on a tiny network

original_idea.body: Accessible reproduction of an unsound-vs-sound robustness certifier (arXiv:2505.06958) on a tiny MLP in plain Python; build a counterexample exploiting a floating-point bug plus the verified fix. CPU-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Demonstrating soundness failures in safety guarantees is valuable but the catastrophic-risk chain is a didactic, indirect one.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Plain Python, tiny MLP, CPU-only; a motivated beginner can do it.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: build one counterexample exploiting an unsound certifier plus a fix.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Verification-pitfall demonstration, no lab access needed, independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Source paper already demonstrates exploitable unsoundness; this is mostly a didactic reproduction.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Unsoundness already shown; reproduction is didactic.
